_help: Room layout used by the 3D view, the localizer, the simulator, the benchmark and train_model.py.
Units are METERS. Origin (0,0) = the room's south-west floor corner, x = east, y = north, z = up.
Pick any wall as 'south' - just be consistent. 20 ft = 6.10 m.
Measure where each board really is (tape measure, +/- 10 cm is fine) and put it here.
Never move a board after recording training data - if you do, calibrate and record again.
receivers: the id is the board's RECEIVER_ID. band '2.4' hears the transmitters; band '5' with
source 'access_point' measures the home router's replies (the C5). 'enabled': false = not in use.
transmitters: the id is the board's NODE_ID (1..10). Remove entries for boards you don't have.
access_point: where your home ROUTER (or the mesh box the C5 connects to) is. in_room: true only if
it really is inside this room - then its link to the C5 also helps place people.
Edit this file, then restart server.py (or POST /api/model/reload).
name: Basement
